sources.note: Scholarship page: research must reference one of five Global South themes; no named subject list; refers to the Postgraduate Course Directory
Funding Search listing: says 114 courses are covered and 134 nationalities; neither list opens
Funding overview page: describes the Funding Search; gives no per-scholarship course list

subject_rule: Limited by theme, not by named subject: the Trust says the research must be undertaken with reference to one of five themes (Energy and infrastructure; Global health solutions; AI, data and digital innovation; Governance, policy and systems; Human identity and culture), and the Funding Search says 114 doctoral courses are covered.
notes: The 114 covered courses and the 134 eligible nationalities are on the listing behind 'See full list' controls that could not be read, so no courses are recorded.
The page names the five themes but does not describe them or map them to named courses.
not_stated: The names of the 114 covered courses.
The list of the 134 eligible nationalities.
fetch_problems: The University of Cambridge Funding Search page for this award shows the number of covered courses but the 'See full list' link is an in-page script control: the course names are not in the page text (only two unrelated 'related course' names appear), so the covered-course list could not be read. It was not worked around.
